sources.title: Diabetic Retinopathy AI Model - GitHub
sources.snippet: Diabetic Retinopathy is a diabetes-related eye disease that can lead to blindness if not detected early. This project aims to classify retinal fundus images into 5 severity classes using deep learning and hybrid machine learning techniques, helping reduce potential misdiagnosis rates by up to 15%.

sources.title: Diabetic Retinopathy Detection: AI Models and Approaches
sources.snippet: Diabetic retinopathy (DR), a major cause of vision loss worldwide, results from chronic diabetes damage to retinal blood vessels. Vision loss can be prevented if DR is detected early, but traditional retinal screening by eye care takes time and expertise.
